turns.user: I validated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00.
turns.agent:
If you’re asking about a ride beginning at 10:00, the 30-minute mobile ticket’s transfer window runs to 10:30. Validate it at the start and again when changing to another line (except between metro lines). If your final transfer happens before 10:30, you may finish that last ride after 10:30; you don’t have to finish the ride by then. It requires an internet-connected phone and has no paper equivalent.

That’s according to the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. See BKK’s 30-minute ticket page for current terms. What time did you make your last transfer, if you’re checking whether you can continue a specific journey?

turns.user: Can I transfer to another tram at 10:31 using that same ticket?
turns.agent: No. Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, the 30-minute transfer window from a 10:00 validation ends at 10:30, so a transfer to another tram at 10:31 is outside the window. The rule allowing you to finish a last ride after the window applies only if your final transfer happened before it expired; it doesn’t extend the time to make another transfer. See BKK’s 30-minute ticket page for current terms.
